title: Theme
description: The colours a chart uses, as tokens (REQ-THEME-010, REQ-THEME-090): the element's `theme` property and option, the JS API, the CLI's `--theme <file.json>`, the Rust crate and the SVG and ANSI exports take this object. Every token is optional; a token left out falls back to the element's `--glyphplot-*` custom property, then to the dark or light default set (REQ-THEME-020). `theme::resolve` turns the tokens into the 255-entry palette: indices 0–31 the tokens in the order ink, muted, rule, accent, ground, up, down, selection, series 1–8, and 32–159 a 128-step ramp of the scale stops (REQ-COLOR-020, REQ-COLOR-040). A theme change repaints from the new palette and draws no new frame (REQ-COLOR-030).

ground.description: The colour behind the chart. Without one the chart draws no ground and is transparent.

ink.description: Text: titles, tick labels, readouts. At least 4.5:1 against the ground by default (REQ-THEME-040).

muted.description: Axes and tick marks. At least 4.5:1 against the ground by default.

rule.description: Gridlines; decoration, exempt from the contrast rules.

accent.description: The crosshair, the brush outline and the focus ring. At least 3:1 against the ground by default.

selection.description: The fill behind a brushed range and selected data.

up.description: A rising candle or bar; a token, never a fixed colour, since markets differ in which colour means up (REQ-THEME-060).

series.description: Series colours 1 to 8, in series order (the custom properties `--glyphplot-series-1` to `-8`). Series past the eighth repeat them, told apart by pattern (REQ-MONO-020). Fewer than eight replaces the first ones only.

scale.description: The sequential scale's stops, low end first, interpolated in Oklab over 128 palette steps; the low end should be the end nearer the ground's lightness (REQ-THEME-080).

diverging.description: The diverging scale's stops, low end first, the middle stop the neutral one.

paper.description: Paper: dark marks on a light ground, in one ink, for print and the exports' paper toggle.
